206:t_2:11.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I knew it... that the life I'd had couldn't go on forever...」

206:t_2:12.en:
$$かなめ$$
「That someday an enemy would come, wreck everything, and take me away...」

206:t_2:15.en:
$$かなめ$$
「If I'd gone with him... with $$レナード$$... I wouldn't have had to drag $$恭子$$ and everyone into this...」

206:t_2:16.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It's all my fault... It's my fault...」

206:t_2:17.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's not true. The enemy is to blame.」

206:t_2:18.en:
$$宗介$$
「Besides, everyone is still safe. If we rescue them, there's no problem.」

206:t_2:19.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...Rescue them? There's no way to do that, however you look at it!」

206:t_2:21.en:
$$かなめ$$
「What are you saying? Are you stupid? The whole school is being held hostage, you know?」

206:t_2:23.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It's not just $$恭子$$. Pros have planted seriously disguised bombs all over the school, haven't they? You'll never find them...」

206:t_2:24.en:
$$宗介$$
「If I had specialized electronic warfare gear... if I had an AS, I could pinpoint the source of the detonator's signal...」

206:t_2:26.en:
$$かなめ$$
「With gear at that enemy's level, they'd send the signal using a communication method that's hard to detect.」

206:t_2:27.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Of course the enemy must be guarding the area around the school. Even an AS with $$ＥＣＳ$$ can't get close.」

206:t_2:28.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It wouldn't be strange if they had wide-area molecular spectrum sensors, interference reverse-detection mics and high-sensitivity magnetic sensors, right?」

206:t_2:29.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Even if you could pinpoint a bomb's position, do you think you could disarm it? You couldn't even examine the inside.」

206:t_2:30.en:
$$かなめ$$
「They can make a trigger that reacts to nuclear magnetic resonance any number of ways. Can't you even understand something that simple?」

206:t_2:31.en:
$$宗介$$
「...$$千鳥$$... I'm sorry. I don't understand what you're saying...」

206:t_2:33.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I see... So you're the same, after all.」

206:t_2:35.en:
$$かなめ$$
「What's with that look? Do you think there's something wrong with my head?」

206:t_2:36.en:
$$宗介$$
「I didn't say that. But you...」

206:t_2:37.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Yes, that's right. It's just as he said.」

206:t_2:38.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It irritates me. When you put on that dumb face, I feel like I'm being made fun of.」

206:t_2:39.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Why can't any of you understand something this simple? Are you all stupid?」

206:t_2:41.en:
$$宗介$$
「That is only an illusion you feel because the $$ウィスパード$$ ability has raised your intelligence beyond the ordinary.」

206:t_2:42.en:
$$宗介$$
「Don't look down on others. Admit that you're sick. Remember, you always...」

206:t_2:43.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...By putting on a worried face, you put yourself in a psychologically superior position...」

206:t_2:44.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Do you think you can seize the initiative with that kind of fake concern? How simple.」

206:t_2:45.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Earlier you said this to me. That you're afraid of me. That you like me, but you're afraid.」

206:t_2:47.en:
$$宗介$$
「So am I. I like you.」

206:t_2:48.en:
$$宗介$$
「But I'm afraid... I can't understand you... But I'm drawn to you...」

206:t_2:49.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's been that over and over. Ever since the day we first met. Nothing like this ever happened to me before.」

206:t_2:50.en:
$$宗介$$
「You're the one who changed my entire world.」

206:t_2:51.en:
$$宗介$$
「I will protect everything... Not only you. I will guard every world that belongs to you.」

206:t_2:54.en:
$$宗介$$
「Lend me your strength to save $$常磐$$ and everyone. I'll make it work, just like I always have.」

206:t_2:55.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Do you really think we can save everything?」

206:t_2:56.en:
$$宗介$$
「Affirmative. If it's you and me.」

206:t_2:58.en:
$$かなめ$$
「In a cheap novel, this would be where the touching kiss scene comes in. But...」

206:t_2:61.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The best thing is to surrender quietly.」

206:t_2:63.en:
$$宗介$$
「...You're probably right. I also know that a dull man like me can't win by arguing with you.」

206:t_2:64.en:
$$宗介$$
「But I want to save you... and at the same time, the people who are important to you.」

206:t_2:65.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The odds of pulling that off aren't even 1%.」

206:t_2:66.en:
$$宗介$$
「...If I can save you, I don't care what happens to the world...」

206:t_2:67.en:
$$宗介$$
「Rather than hand you over to them, I'll do anything...」

206:t_2:69.en:
$$宗介$$
「...A stun gun. I'm sorry, $$千鳥$$...」

206:t_2:71.en:
$$宗介$$
「If $$アル$$ were here, he would surely call this irrational...」

206:t_2:72.en:
$$宗介$$
(...$$千鳥$$... You won't forgive me for making this choice.)

206:t_2:73.en:
$$宗介$$
(But this is all I... This is the only way I can think of...)

206:t_2:74.en:
$$宗介$$
(I'll keep my promise... I will guard everything that belongs to you.)

206:t_2:75.en:
$$宗介$$
(I don't have a single ally, but I have no choice...! Even if there's only a 1% chance, I'll bet on it!)

206:t_3:3.en: ～ $$陣代高校$$, Old Building, Empty Classroom ～

206:t_3:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「Wait there. I'm freeing you now.」

206:t_3:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「I've disarmed the explosive on your body too. You're all right now.」

206:t_3:8.en:
$$恭子$$
「I don't get it... What's going on with this...?」

206:t_3:9.en:
$$恭子$$
「Some people with guns suddenly attacked us and shoved us into a place like this...!」

206:t_3:11.en:
$$恭子$$
「...I kind of get it. $$誰か$$'s after $$カナ$$-chan, right?」

206:t_3:12.en:
$$恭子$$
「That's why everyone got caught up in it on the school trip and ended up in danger...」

206:t_3:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$千鳥$$ is not at fault.」

206:t_3:14.en:
$$恭子$$
「Then why, $$カナ$$-chan... didn't you say a single word to me about it!? I thought I was your best friend!」

206:t_3:16.en:
$$恭子$$
「You know about it, don't you...」

206:t_3:17.en:
$$恭子$$
「Only $$カナ$$-chan and you know? Weren't we friends?」

常磐.evidence: Sousuke's surname form for Kyoko Tokiwa (常盤恭子 in glossary, here written 常磐); no surname-only token in the sheet

uncertain: 206:t_2:37: あいつ rendered 'he' (Kaname used あいつ for Leonard at t_2:15; Leonard's earlier remark is in the untranslated Blue Earth/earlier part)
206:t_2:41/42: ウィスパード is unlinked here (0 links) so plain 'Whispered ability' used; 自分の病気 = 'you're sick'
206:t_2:45: direction: Kaname earlier said SHE is afraid of Sousuke (俺の事が怖い)
206:t_2:15: キョーコ (katakana) uses the 恭子 token; 常磐 (磐, differs from glossary 常盤) proposed as new name token 'Tokiwa'
206:t_2:54: 常磐 as Sousuke's surname for Kyoko
206:t_2:61: 降参 = surrender (Kaname urging Sousuke to give up to Amalgam)
